jobs.title: How Long You'd Last on Each Planet
jobs.description:
How long could you survive on each planet without a spacesuit? On Mercury and Mars about 2 minutes, but on Venus you'd be crushed and cooked in less than a second. Only one planet lets you last a lifetime.

#space #planets #whatif #science #shorts
